title: Negative Adverbial Inversion
prompt: Rarely ______ located near city lights or at lower elevations because light pollution interferes with astronomical observations.
explanation: Ketika kalimat diawali adverbia negatif ('Rarely', 'Never', 'Seldom'), subjek dan auxiliary verb wajib mengalami inversi menjadi 'are observatories'.

title: Reduced & Non-Restrictive Relative Clauses
prompt: The outer ear, ______ the fleshy pinna and the auditory canal, picks up and funnels sound waves toward the eardrum.
explanation: Klausa apositif penjelas di antara dua koma memerlukan relative pronoun 'which' diikuti kata kerja tunggal 'includes'.

title: Subjunctive Mood in Academic English
prompt: The university senate recommended that every international applicant ______ an English proficiency assessment prior to enrollment.
explanation: Kata kerja subjunctive ('recommend', 'suggest', 'insist') diikuti 'that + subject + bare infinitive' (tanpa -s/es), yaitu 'complete'.

title: Parallel Structure in Written Expression
prompt:
Pilih bagian kata/frasa yang SALAH secara grammar:
"The new superconducting material is prized for [A] its high tensile strength, [B] resistance to corrosion, and [C] it conducts electricity [D] efficiently."
explanation: Struktur paralel harus setara berupa Noun Phrase ('its high tensile strength', 'resistance to corrosion', dan seharusnya 'efficient electrical conductivity'), bukan klausa 'it conducts electricity'.
